title: Well-posedness for a class of $n\times n$ hyperbolic systems and shock stability for the viscous approximation
summary: We establish the global well-posedness of weak solutions to the Cauchy problem for a broad class of multi-dimensional $n\times n$ Keyfitz-Kranzer type systems with homogeneous flux. Our proof relies on a novel viscous approximation that yields the necessary compactness estimates. By exploiting the specific structure of this proposed approximation, we derive a priori uniform $L^{\infty}$ bounds and prove the $L^1_{loc}$ precompactness of the sequence of approximate solutions.
